description: Measure the combined supply share held by the ten largest SPL token accounts and report mint authorities. Accounts are not necessarily unique people or wallets. Example: {"mint":"EPjFWdd5AufqSSqeM2qN1xzybapC8G4wEGGkZwyTDt1v"} Cost: 3 free calls, then $0.005 USDC per call via x402. Calls that return an error are not charged.

mint.description: SPL token mint address in Base58 format, not a ticker symbol.

network.description: Solana cluster to query. Use mainnet-beta for real assets or devnet for test data; defaults to mainnet-beta.
